@@U01182@@
I can’t bear to know my darling’s sad. Get her another set at once! The first wasn’t worth much, anyway.

@@U01184@@
Yes, of course! You think this is all just child’s play!

@@U01186@@
Go on! Do as I say! And get something going with that neighbor of hers. Damn you, get a move on! And bring me a new set of jewels!

@@U01188@@
(Ironically.)

@@U01189@@
Whatever you say, Your Lordship! With all my heart!

@@U01190@@
(Ect 浮士德)

@@U01191@@
It’s lovesick fools like this whod puff out sun, moon, and stars, only to amuse their lady loves!

@@U01192@@
(Exit.)

@@U01195@@
God forgive him, that dear husband of mine— but he really didn’t do right by me. Off he goes into the wide world, leaving me to fend for myself. And why? I never gave him cause. God knows I loved him so.

@@U01196@@
(She weeps.)
translation:
@@U01182@@
我不忍心知道我亲爱的伤心。赶紧给她再买一套吧！无论如何，第一个不值多少钱。

@@U01184@@
是的，当然！你以为这只是儿戏！

@@U01186@@
继续！按我说的做！和她的邻居一起做点什么。该死的你快点行动吧！并给我带来一套新的珠宝！

@@U01188@@
（讽刺的是。）

@@U01189@@
无论您说什么，陛下！我全心全意！

@@U01190@@
（浮士德等）

@@U01191@@
像这样的相思傻瓜，才会吹出日月星辰，只为取悦心爱的女人！

@@U01192@@
（退出。）

@@U01195@@
上帝原谅他，我亲爱的丈夫——但他确实没有对我做任何事。他离开了，进入了广阔的世界，留下我自己照顾自己。为什么？我从来没有给过他理由。天知道我如此爱他。

@@U01196@@
（她哭了。）
